description: World Electric Power Plants Database, March 2017 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors S&P Global Market Intelligence (Firm). Worldwide inventory of electric power generating units. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. Formats: PDF, Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (the dataset page says only that it "is made available with limited information on how it can be used"). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
